messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up — NewBridge procurement paused POC signoff. CFO needs three items before exec approval: 1) BYO KMS with no key export, 2) Okta SSO + SCIM provisioning, 3) a short pilot latency commitment. Need quick triage.
Ibrahim (SE): Ack. Clarify: they require keys never leave their HSM?
Maya (AE): Yes, they said HSM-only live ops.
Zoe (Presales): Reality: live HSM RPC peering isn't standard for us. Options: a) KMS-proxy forwarding signing to their HSM over mTLS, b) cloud KMS with strict import controls. Both need security/legal review.
Ken (SRE): Ops note: target 600 qps, seq=64. With Dedicated + aggressive batching + KV cache we can aim for p95 ≈ 180-220ms. Third-party HSM latency will add tail.
Ruth (Security): Security asks: vendor FIPS cert, network diagram, MTLS config, attestation form. Live peering increases risk surface — will run a quick threat outline.
Paul (Legal): Legal: we can prepare a KMS addendum and a pilot SLA with limited credits, but HSM peering needs a crypto addendum and liability limits. Send any redlines.
Maya (AE): They also want a 2-week pilot SLA: p95 <= 220ms, 99.5% availability during the window. Is that something we can promise?
Ken (SRE): 99.5% for a controlled short pilot is doable if we control infra, but peer HSM uptime is outside our control. Recommend a fallback: auto-fail to cached responses or a smaller model if peering degrades.
Ibrahim (SE): I'll draft two diagrams (direct HSM peering and KMS-proxy fallback) and a short Okta/SCIM runbook.
Zoe (Presales): Proposed timeline for the bridge: Day 0-2 contract + KMS addendum; Day 3-5 network cert exchange and MTLS test; Day 6-8 perf runs; Day 9 exec bridge.
Ruth (Security): Action: I'll request their HSM vendor certs and the SOC contact. Also will start the attestation template.
Paul (Legal): I'll pre-draft a crypto addendum and the pilot SLA with credit schedule. Maya, cc me procurement redlines.
Maya (AE): Can we do an exec bridge tomorrow 9:30am PT? Customer insists on morning slot.
Ken (SRE): 9:30am PT works for SRE. I'll join with an ops checklist and a fallback plan.
Ibrahim (SE): I'll join and bring diagrams + tuning knobs (`--kv-cache-enabled`, `--batch-policy=aggressive`).
Zoe (Presales): I'll prepare a 3-slide deck: options, timeline, risks.
notify-bot: Ticket NB-55821 created: "NewBridge POC - HSM peering, Okta, pilot SLA" assigned to eng-oncall. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NB-55821
Maya (AE): Owners: Ibrahim -> diagrams & runbook; Ken -> perf run & ops checklist; Zoe -> bridge slides & timeline; Ruth -> attestation + risk note; Paul -> crypto addendum. I'll coordinate calendar and customer comms.
